en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin Aiz, from Ibn Azina, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya Al Ijaly who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [9:119] Fear Allah and be with the truthful ones.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from al-Washfiha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘A’idh from ibn ’Udhayna from t Burayd ibn Mu‘awiya al-‘Ijli who has said that he asked Imam abu Ja’far (a.s.)
about the meaning of the following verse of the Holy Quran. “Believers, be pious before God and always be friends with the truthful ones.” [9:119]
The Imam (a.s.) replied, “ ‘The truthful ones’ is a reference to us.”
